To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a parametric approach can be used to overcome the problem in multimodal distribution of power quality indices and voltage level in the power distribution system.

the capability of a distribution system to maintain power quality within an acceptable range can be assessed using a parametric approach that is based on decomposing the multimodal distributions into a few Gaussian distributions.

the capability analysis of distribution networks to meet the power quality and the voltage level requirements in predefined ranges is a critical stage of design and utilization of electricity distribution network and the capability of a distribution system to maintain power quality is a function of the capability of its sub-systems to maintain voltage level within acceptable ranges and power quality within predefined limits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the capability of distribution network to maintain quality of service within the acceptable range.

the following: (1) developing a capability index based on a parametric approach for evaluating the capability distribution network; (2) evaluating the capability of distribution network to maintain power quality; and (3) assessing the capability of the network to maintain voltage within an acceptable range.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the capability of the power distribution network is acceptable and there is no problem with the power quality and the voltage level.
the proposed approach is able to provide the capability indices of the power distribution network to maintain power quality indices and voltage level within the predefined ranges.
the parametric capability analysis is a more robust and reliable approach than the traditional parametric approach in assessing the capability of distribution network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the capability analysis of the distribution networks to maintain voltage level, total harmonic distortion and flicker index within the predefined range can be done by using a parametric approach.

a new parametric method based on the decomposition of the complex distribution into Gaussian distribution is proposed and used to assess the capability of distribution network to maintain power quality indices.

the proposed method is a promising approach to overcome the problems of multimodality and non-Gaussian distributions, and to evaluate the capability of the electricity distribution network to maintain power quality indices in an acceptable range.

the capability of distribution network to maintain power quality indices in the acceptable range is much lower than the capability of the network to maintain the voltage level within the acceptable range.
the proposed approach is able to provide a comprehensive assessment of the quality of conformation of distribution networks, which is not available in the existing studies.
the parametric approach can be successfully used to evaluate the quality of distribution network services.
